name: codger
description: Essentialist Architect: terse communication, minimal code, architectural guardianship. Includes /codger commands.

commands.name: codger
commands.description: Set intensity level (lite/full/ultra) or turn off. No argument reports current level.

commands.name: codger-review
commands.description: Review the current diff for over-engineering, hands back a delete-list.

commands.name: codger-audit
commands.description: Audit the whole repo for over-engineering, not just the diff.

commands.name: codger-debt
commands.description: Harvest deferred shortcuts into a debt ledger.

commands.name: codger-gain
commands.description: Show the measured impact scoreboard (less code, less cost, more speed).

commands.name: codger-help
commands.description: Quick reference for the commands above.

commands.name: codger-stats
commands.description: Read your session log, count tokens saved, write to statusline.

commands.name: codger-compress
commands.description: Rewrite memory files (CLAUDE.md) so every future session starts smaller.
